SELECT l.app_key AS appKey, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status >= 200 AND l.status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(l.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, AVG(l.latency_ms) AS avgLatencyMs, MAX(l.create_time) AS lastAt
GROUP BY l.app_key ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status >= 200 AND l.status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(l.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, AVG(l.latency_ms) AS avgLatencyMs, MAX(l.create_time) AS lastAt

SELECT instance_id AS instanceId, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, AVG(latency_ms) AS avgLatencyMs, MAX(create_time) AS lastAt FROM sys_ai_service_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id <> '' GROUP BY instance_id

SELECT instance_id AS instanceId, FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, #{since}, create_time) / #{bucketMinutes}) AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM sys_ai_service_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id <> '' GROUP BY instance_id, bucket ORDER BY instance_id, bucket

SELECT t.instance_id AS instanceId, t.latency_ms AS p95Ms FROM ( SELECT instance_id, latency_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instance_id ORDER BY latency_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY instance_id) AS cnt FROM sys_ai_service_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id <> '' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.rn = CEIL(t.cnt * 0.95)
